        ((f x : Subgroup.zpowers a) : G) = b * (x : G) * b⁻¹ := by

    fun x hx => hN.conj_mem x hx b
  have hmem_inv : ∀ x : G, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a → b⁻¹ * x * b ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hN.conj_mem x hx b⁻¹
    simpa using h

    apply Subtype.ext
    show b * (b⁻¹ * (y : G) * b) * b⁻¹ = (y : G)

    Function.Bijective f ∧
      ∀ x : Subgroup.zpowers a,
        ((f x : Subgroup.zpowers a) : G) = b * (x : G) * b⁻¹ := by
  haveI hN : (Subgroup.zpowers a).Normal := hG (Subgroup.zpowers a)
  let f : Subgroup.zpowers a →* Subgroup.zpowers a :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨b * (x : G) * b⁻¹, hN.conj_mem (x : G) x.prop b⟩
      map_one' := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp
      map_mul' := fun x y => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show b * ((x : G) * (y : G)) * b⁻¹ =
          (b * (x : G) * b⁻¹) * (b * (y : G) * b⁻¹)
        group
    }
  refine ⟨f, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro x y h
    have hval : b * (x : G) * b⁻¹ = b * (y : G) * b⁻¹ :=
      congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hx : (x : G) = (y : G) := by
      calc (x : G) = b⁻¹ * (b * (x : G) * b⁻¹) * b := by group
        _ = b⁻¹ * (b * (y : G) * b⁻¹) * b := by rw [hval]
        _ = (y : G) := by group
    exact Subtype.ext hx
  · intro y
    have hmem : b⁻¹ * (y : G) * b ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a := by
      have h : b⁻¹ * (y : G) * (b⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a :=
        hN.conj_mem (y : G) y.prop (b⁻¹)
      simpa [inv_inv] using h
    refine ⟨⟨b⁻¹ * (y : G) * b, hmem⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    show b * (b⁻¹ * (y : G) * b) * b⁻¹ = (y : G)
    group
  · intro x
    rfl
